**STEP 6 - Grams:** Whole fruit is dense, so I use about 0.7 g/ml as the effective density, which gives about 225 g. A typical medium apple is about 180–200 g, so I take 190 g as the estimate.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Apple ≈ 52 kcal/100 g. 190 g × 0.52 ≈ 99 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** A single medium apple on a dinner-size plate (about 190 g, roughly 100 kcal) is plausible. The plate is mostly empty, so the total is small.
